title: Identification and comparison of circular RNAs in Preeclampsia
description: In the present study, the circular RNA (circRNA) expression patterns of normal pregnant women and PE patients were investigated using whole RNA sequencing. 151 differential expressed circRNAs were identified including 121 upregulated and 30 downregulated ones.
